If a response arrived, notify Chris if not already done and do not email. schedules.name: july-backfill-five-days
schedules.text: Run the daily July backwards ingestion backlog. Read `workspace/threads/backfill/files/july-backlog-plan.md` first, then process the next listed block (up to five July dates) under its superseded-drop policy: do not ingest an older supplier email when later supplier availability has already been successfully ingested. Use task threads/coordinators, keep same suppliers serialized, and label every reviewed email. Update the plan current position after a completed block. After the final July 1 block, pause/remove this schedule and message `main` asking Chris and Bhoumik whether to continue farther back.
